turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Elaine. Adrian Lim speaking. Thanks for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would you prefer me to call you back?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Now is good, Adrian. I'm at home with my statements beside me. I prefer speaking on the phone for the administration; easier than going back and forth by email.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly, we can talk here. Before we get into the details, I'll need your usual identification information for the call.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_012]] [[EV_013]] I've got my folder open already, so I won't need to go looking for anything.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Elaine. I'll finish the verification on my side. You can tell me what brought you to call today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_014]] [[EV_015]] My notes are a bit short, so I thought better to speak to you directly.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: All right. While I'm opening your records, how have you been keeping the statements? Still using the paper folder, or mostly electronic copies now?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Both, actually. I save the files, but I still print the pages I want to look at. Otherwise I keep switching windows and lose my place.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For the filing, keeping the original statement separate from your handwritten notes can make the paperwork easier to find later.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, that's how I arrange the folder. [[EV_016]] [[EV_020]] [[EV_017]] [[EV_018]] [[EV_019]] [[EV_021]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Well, let me put it in my own words. [[EV_008]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for giving your own answer. Separately, for routine follow-up calls, is your usual telephone number still the best way to reach you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, use the usual number. If I don't pick up, leave a simple message asking me to call back. No need to put details in the voicemail.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That's fine for contact arrangements. [[EV_009]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll handle the administration from here. Any follow-up paperwork will be available through the usual correspondence channel, so you can keep it with your statements.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, I'll look out for the paperwork there. I like keeping everything together rather than having bits scattered across different folders.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Of course. If you have trouble finding a document, you can contact me for help with that. Thanks for your time, Elaine.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Adrian. That's all from me today. Have a good afternoon, bye.
